delivered_contract: Research schemas, dispatcher, executor, agent and providers require one validated ForecastContext and run_id and fail closed before provider execution when identity is absent or inconsistent.

Historical Tavily, News and SEC paths use only retained allowlisted and versioned evidence, never substitute current web, enforce filed_at on or before as_of, and reject future or unknown timestamps before synthesis and again before Shared State.

Evidence and citation identities are deterministic and dataset-version-aware; typed ResearchFeatures and aggregated context persist compact references and counts rather than article, filing, citation or synthesis payloads.
Vector-only, Graph-only and Hybrid retrieval preserve explicit degradation metadata and the accepted temporal Graph/RAG contract.

LangSmith, MCP, lifecycle, log, progress, Sentry and State telemetry is compact, allowlisted and attributed to Stage 04B revision 1 attempt 3 through implementation identity stage04b-r1-a3, with raw query, plan, arguments, exceptions, URLs, evidence, citations, synthesis, checker missing text and checker score excluded.
The legacy prompt typo is removed from runtime and test references; prompt_research_agent.py is the canonical Research prompt module.
known_limitations: No live News, SEC, Tavily, Vector, Graph or Hybrid provider validation was authorized or used as acceptance evidence; closure is based on deterministic offline fixtures, mocks and regression tests.

A legacy integration probe in Attempt 1 accidentally performed read-only News and SEC calls, was stopped immediately, made no external or database write, and was not rerun or used as acceptance evidence.
The declared Stage 04B point-in-time fixture is retained for reproducibility, while some deterministic coverage continues to use inline local fixtures.
Stage 05 remains PENDING, NOT_STARTED and inactive until separately authorized.
